## Complete available rendered final

Result

I have constructed and executed a complete-process model, but I have not established an economical invention that meets your combined requirements. The candidate below has a specific transport mechanism, obtainable constituent materials, a manufacturing and service scheme, complete campaign ledgers, and a discriminating experiment. Its calculated energy and cost still miss the targets, and several coupled material states remain unmeasured.

The proposed operation is controlled water flow through a porous proton-conducting bridge toward an air cathode, with local hydraulic balancing and separate peroxide drainage. Its purpose is to reduce peroxide destruction without relying on an ideal selective membrane. The consequential question is whether that protection survives real current distribution, bubbles, adsorption, corrosion and repeated servicing.

The completed deliverables are:

Report, executable models, results and source register
